# GI KERNEL V2.4 — THE WAVE PLAN
WAVES: 6
Authority: reports/GI_KERNEL_V2.4_DPL1_SPEC.md · Blueprint: reports/ENFORCEMENT_BLUEPRINT_v1.md

## THE ONE LAW
EVERY WAVE CARRIES AN EDGE, NOT A FILE. A wave naming only a file and no edge is REFUSED.

## W1 — THE LOCAL JUDGE → THE PROSE ADJUDICATOR
  edge:   the local judge (:8090) → the lexicon-gate's gray-band decision
  files:  extensions.DISABLED-20260924/lexicon-gate/lib.ts (the URL + model rewire)
  deliverable: the ledger row carries "jev":0.<p> (not null) for a gray-band span
  gate:   tail ~/.omp/run/lexicon-ledger.jsonl → 0 rows with jev:null after a fire

## W2 — THE RETRIEVAL MANDATE → THE READ PATH
  edge:   a raw corpus read → the gate → REFUSED + the jev remedy
  files:  src/omp/gate-hook.ts (a bash branch) + ~/.omp/agent/config.yml (bash.patterns)
  deliverable: a grep/sed over an indexable corpus throws GI_RETRIEVAL_GATE with the remedy
  gate:   the token appears IN A TOOL RESULT; a jev query SERVES (the negative half)

## W3 — THE GRAPH-QUERY → THE EDIT PATH
  edge:   a structural edit → the gate → GI_QUERY_REQUIRED when no session query exists
  files:  src/omp/graph-gate.ts (extend the candidate classes beyond stripped-exports)
  deliverable: an un-queried structural edit is refused; a queried edit serves
  gate:   the token in a tool result; the graph_gate_state table records the query history

## W4 — THE DERAIL CLASSES → THE GATE
  edge:   a loop / a banned approach / an ignored directive → the gate → REFUSED
  files:  src/omp/gate-hook.ts (a rolling command counter + a ban table + the directives)
  deliverable: the same cd x3 trips the loop gate; the operator's CDP ban is a predicate
  gate:   the loop-refusal token; 3 DISTINCT commands serve (the negative half)

## W5 — THE DONE-CLAIM → THE JEV ROUTE=ACT GATE
  edge:   a completion claim → the Jev judge → route=act required
  files:  scripts/goal-verify.ts + the gate
  deliverable: "done" without route=act is refused; with it, serves
  gate:   GI_DONE_UNPROVEN; route=act serves

## W6 — THE SUBSTRATE → EACH WORKSPACE
  edge:   a code-edit session → populate-on-first-run → the store exists
  files:  scripts/gi-populate.ts + the per-workspace .omp/lsp.json
  deliverable: an empty workspace is blocked with GI_NO_SUBSTRATE; populate auto-runs
  gate:   consumption-audit <that root> --gate reads 8/8 ON THAT ROOT

## THE FIREWALL (every wave's close)
  scripts/v24-firewall.sh — every detector, one command, exit nonzero = FAIL
  detectors: the decorative gate · the remote judge · the null judge · the ungated edit ·
             the raw corpus read · the silent fallback · the done-without-proof

## THE RUNTIME PROOF (every wave)
  /prove-it ONLY. No unit-test-as-evidence. The PROOF_LEDGER at forensic/PROOF_LEDGER_v24.md.
